name: After § 3
title: People’s Republic of China’s misinterpretation of the UN resolution 2758 and its continuous military provocations around Taiwan
part_text: 3a. Deplores the increased military support given to Taiwan by the United States, including the provision of advanced weapons and military cooperation, which are actions that risk provoking a dangerous arms race and military escalation in the Taiwan Strait and the broader Indo-Pacific region;
